_README: Zoom does NOT accept this file as an upload. A Meeting SDK app is configured
by filling in the form at https://marketplace.zoom.us. This file is a checklist
of the exact values to enter there, kept in the repo so the setup is reproducible.
Replace every <PLACEHOLDER>. Never commit the client secret.

required_feature._why: Without this toggle the app still issues a Client ID/Secret, but they cannot sign a valid meeting join. This is the single most common cause of a failed first join.

app_credentials.client_secret: <KEEP OUT OF GIT — paste only into the server's env>

urls._why: The Meeting SDK checks the origin the page is served from. If the deployed URL is missing here, joins are rejected even with correct credentials.

activation.state_required: Activated, or your own Zoom account added under Local Test / Add Test Users
activation._why: Marketplace apps sit in a draft state after creation. A draft app rejects joins.

server_env._where: Replit: Tools -> Secrets. Restart the server after setting these.
server_env._verify: GET /health -> zoom.configured must be true and zoom.likelySwapped false

signature_the_server_generates._note: Emitted by server.js#zoomSignature and sent to the browser by POST /zoom-signature. Shown here so the shape can be checked against Zoom's docs. HS256, signed with the client secret, which never leaves the server.

troubleshooting.3712: Signature invalid — Client ID/Secret mismatch, or the Meeting SDK feature is not enabled on the app.
troubleshooting.no_zoom_tab_in_app: Server does not see the env vars. Check /health, then restart.
troubleshooting.join_button_does_nothing: Old service worker serving stale code. Reload in a private tab, or clear website data.
troubleshooting.sdk_version_error: js/zoom.js walks SDK_VERSIONS newest-first; if all fail, set window.HALO_ZOOM_SDK_VERSION to a current version from Zoom's release notes.
